title: Quick Start
use_cases: Configure when starting the system for the first time after a boot
Implement when needing to retrieve context from a knowledge graph via CLI
Use when adding research papers or external URLs to the local index via LLM chat
Use when inspecting specific document metadata or content by ID
Configure when verification of graph statistics and size is required
content:
**Prerequisites:** Claude Code with Firecrawl MCP configured (see Setup below)

```bash
# 1. Start the embedding service (once per boot)
source .venv/bin/activate
python embedding_service.py &

# 2. Query the knowledge graph (works from any directory)
kg query "quantum mechanics entanglement" 5
kg stats
kg show <doc_id>  # Use unique doc ID from query results
```

**To add documents:** Ask Claude Code in chat:

```
"Add https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0609062 to the knowledge graph"
"Add https://arxiv.org/abs/1312.2007 to the knowledge graph"
```

Claude will scrape with Firecrawl MCP and automatically ingest.
